personality_one_liner: An elegant, warm, and premium Indonesian 'warung modern' POS that feels like a welcoming cafe menu rather than a clinical cash register.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Minimalist, uncluttered cards with intentional padding.

do's: Keep everything solid and tactile to maintain the organic editorial/hand-drawn warmth.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism, it clashes with the warm, paper-like aesthetic of Kantin Insya.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry for Owner / Cashier roles.

states.error: Soft red warning text below input.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top featuring a warm coffee/food shot with a vertical gradient scrim to blend into the cream background. Large Serif welcoming title. Simple Role selection tabs (Owner / Cashier) using pill shapes. Clean, unboxed text inputs with thin bottom borders, followed by a large forest green primary CTA.

screens.name: POS / Kasir (Home)
screens.purpose: Primary order-taking interface for the cashier.

states.empty: Illustration of a plate with 'Belum ada menu di kategori ini'.

screens.layout: Top Header: Serif greeting 'Mau makan apa hari ini?' with a hamburger menu left, profile avatar right. Below: Horizontal scrolling pill category chips (Selected: brandPrimary filled, Unselected: surfaceSecondary with subtle border). Middle: 2-column grid of soft beige product tiles (image + title + Rp price). Bottom: Sticky cart bar in dark forest green showing item count, total price, and 'Lihat pesanan' button. Nav: Bottom Tabs (Menu, Pesanan, Riwayat, Profil).

screens.name: Pesanan / Cart & Checkout
screens.purpose: Review current order, apply payment, and confirm.

states.empty: Empty state illustration: Empty tray with 'Belum ada pesanan'.

screens.layout: List of selected items with quantity steppers (+/-). Payment section offering Cash, QRIS, and Transfer options as distinct bordered cards. 'Bayar' CTA pinned to the bottom. Once paid, trigger the Receipt Dialog/Sheet.

screens.name: Receipt / Post-Sale Dialog
screens.purpose: Provide options to print or skip receipt automatically (no auto-print).

states.loading: Spinner while connecting to bluetooth printer.
states.error: Red text 'Gagal mencetak, cek koneksi printer'.

screens.layout: Bottom Sheet layout. Displays 'Pembayaran Berhasil!'. Shows total amount, change (Kembalian) if cash, and clear CTAs: 'Cetak Struk' (Print), 'Bagikan' (Share), and a muted 'Lewati' (Skip) button.

screens.name: Side Drawer Menu
screens.purpose: Global app navigation for management and settings.
screens.layout: Warm cream background. List items: Kasir, Laporan Harian, Laporan Audit, Produk, Modal, Pengaturan Lainnya, Keluar. Each item has a soft beige square badge containing the icon. Typography is sans-serif base size.

screens.name: Laporan Harian (Daily Report)
screens.purpose: View today's sales summary and net profit.

states.empty: Icon showing 'Belum ada transaksi hari ini'.

screens.layout: Grid of summary cards (Total Revenue, Item Count, Net Profit). A bar chart or list showing sales broken down by payment method (Cash vs QRIS/Transfer).

login_hero.alt: Iced coffee with milk in a warm cafe setting

empty_cart.alt: Top down shot of empty plate/nasi goreng as a placeholder

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality combined with the specific Kantin Insya color palette. The background MUST be the warm cream (#F6F0E4), and the primary accent MUST be the deep forest green (#1F3A2E).
Typography MUST mix Fraunces for large Display titles (e.g., 'Mau makan apa hari ini?', 'Total Harga') and Plus Jakarta Sans for UI body, metrics, and labels.
Format all currencies in Indonesian Rupiah (Rp X.XXX). Ensure comma and dot placements match IDR standards.
Do NOT implement auto-printing for receipts. Explicitly build a post-sale dialog/sheet with 'Cetak Struk', 'Bagikan', and 'Lewati' buttons.
The Home screen should have a prominent sticky cart bar at the bottom using the brandPrimary background, summarizing the cart and providing a checkout CTA.
The Side Drawer should style list items with a soft beige square background specifically behind the icons, matching the 'Kantin Insya' reference request.
Avoid glassmorphism. Use solid, tactile layers that emphasize the warm, paper-like editorial feel.
Ensure the layout structure accommodates typical POS workflows on smaller screens, keeping tap targets (especially product cards and cart steppers) at least 48-56px tall.
